mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (receiver_id, sender_id, ticket_id, message_type, title, content, is_read, create_time, deleted) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{ticketId}, #{messageType}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE message SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
